name: spreadsheetSetCellHyperlink
description: Adds a hyperlink to a cell in the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook. Rows and columns are 1-based. When the cell is empty its visible text defaults to the link itself; pass a value with setCellValue first to control the display text. An optional tooltip is shown on hover in the spreadsheet application. The fluent member form is setCellHyperlink(link, row, column, tooltip).

params.name: tooltip
params.description: Optional tooltip text shown on hover.

examples.title: Add a hyperlink
examples.description: Link B2 to example.com with a tooltip.
